blocks.text: Pakistan ko kai qaumi masail ka saamna hai jo technology se hal ho sakte hain. Sehat ke shobe mein rasai (accessibility) kam aur wasail ki kami hai; taleem mein miyar (quality) aur door tak pohanch (outreach) ki rukawatein hain; zaraat mein kam efficiency aur kam paidawar hai; aur hukmrani ko transparency aur efficiency chahiye. In masail ko pehchanna ba-maani hal banane ka pehla qadam hai.

Emerging technologies in mein se bohat si kamiyan poori kar sakti hain. AI medical data analyze kar ke beemari jaldi pehchan sakti hai, IoT zaraat mein mahol ki halat dekh sakta hai, Cloud Computing taleemi mawad ko achhi tarah store aur taqseem kar sakti hai, aur Blockchain hukmrani mein transparency la sakta hai. Yeh ijadaat sarkari khidmat ko shehriyon ke liye zyada smart, qabil-e-rasai aur qabil-e-bharosa bana sakti hain.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Technology Pakistan ke bare masail, jaise pani ki kami, taleem tak kam rasai aur sehat ki sahulat pohanchane, mein madad kar sakti hai.

blocks.caption: Masla aur technology ka hal
rows: AI: medical data se tez diagnosis
Cloud: taleemi mawad store aur taqseem

blocks.prompt: Kitab ke mutabiq hal dhoondne ka pehla qadam kya hai? Aik shoba aur us ki technology ki misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam masail ko pehchanna (recognize karna) hai. Misal: governance mein Blockchain shaffafiyat yaqeeni banata hai (ya healthcare mein AI tez diagnosis).

items: Pakistan ke masail: sehat, taleem, zaraat, governance.
AI, IoT, Cloud aur Blockchain in kamiyon (gaps) ko pura kar sakte hain.
